newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK leader-designate sees popularity soar.
newsitem.headline: HK leader-designate sees popularity soar.

text.p: Hong Kong's leader-designate, Tung Chee-hwa, has soared to a record high in popularity ratings, an opinion poll showed on Thursday.

The poll, conducted by the University of Hong Kong after Tung's selection on December 11 by a Beijing-appointed panel as the territory's Chief Executive-designate, showed his popularity rating at 70.1 marks.

The poll, which surveyed 1,301 people, reflected the level of acceptance in Hong Kong for the shipping magnate, who will take over from colonial Governor Chris Patten after Britain hands Hong Kong back to China on midnight next June 30, the university said in a statement.
